CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `leads2` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `firstName` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `lastName` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(320),
  `phone` varchar(30),
  `whatsapp` varchar(30),
  `company` varchar(255),
  `propertyAddress` text,
  `city` varchar(100),
  `state` varchar(50),
  `zipCode` varchar(10),
  `latitude` varchar(20),
  `longitude` varchar(20),
  `monthlyEnergyBill` decimal(10,2),
  `estimatedSavings` decimal(10,2),
  `roofCondition` varchar(50),
  `sunExposure` varchar(50),
  `homeownershipType` varchar(50),
  `installationTimeline` varchar(50),
  `status` enum('new','contacted','qualified','converted','lost') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
  `priority` enum('low','medium','high','urgent') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',
  `leadScore` int DEFAULT 0,
  `source` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'manual',
  `tags` json,
  `assignedTo` int,
  `isDnc` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `notes` text,
  `lastContactedAt` timestamp,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `leads2_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `leadActivity2` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `leadId` int NOT NULL,
  `userId` int,
  `activityType` enum('created','status_changed','note_added','email_sent','sms_sent','whatsapp_sent','call_made','tag_added','tag_removed','score_updated','assigned','imported','scraped') NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `metadata` json,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `leadActivity2_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `campaigns2` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `channel` enum('email','sms','whatsapp','phone','multi') NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('draft','active','paused','completed','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `targetLeadCount` int DEFAULT 0,
  `sentCount` int DEFAULT 0,
  `deliveredCount` int DEFAULT 0,
  `openedCount` int DEFAULT 0,
  `respondedCount` int DEFAULT 0,
  `convertedCount` int DEFAULT 0,
  `scheduledAt` timestamp,
  `startedAt` timestamp,
  `completedAt` timestamp,
  `filters` json,
  `createdBy` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `campaigns2_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `messageTemplates2` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `channel` enum('email','sms','whatsapp') NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(255),
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `variables` json,
  `isDefault` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `usageCount` int DEFAULT 0,
  `createdBy` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `messageTemplates2_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `outreachMessages2` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `leadId` int NOT NULL,
  `campaignId` int,
  `templateId` int,
  `channel` enum('email','sms','whatsapp','phone') NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(255),
  `body` text,
  `status` enum('queued','sent','delivered','opened','responded','failed','bounced') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued',
  `scheduledAt` timestamp,
  `sentAt` timestamp,
  `deliveredAt` timestamp,
  `openedAt` timestamp,
  `respondedAt` timestamp,
  `errorMessage` text,
  `abVariant` varchar(10),
  `metadata` json,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `outreachMessages2_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `campaignSteps2` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `campaignId` int NOT NULL,
  `stepOrder` int NOT NULL,
  `channel` enum('email','sms','whatsapp','phone') NOT NULL,
  `templateId` int,
  `delayDays` int DEFAULT 0,
  `delayHours` int DEFAULT 0,
  `subject` varchar(255),
  `body` text,
  `abVariantB` text,
  `abSubjectB` varchar(255),
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `campaignSteps2_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `scrapeJobs2` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `source` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `query` text,
  `status` enum('pending','running','completed','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `totalFound` int DEFAULT 0,
  `totalImported` int DEFAULT 0,
  `errorMessage` text,
  `createdBy` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `completedAt` timestamp,
  CONSTRAINT `scrapeJobs2_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tags2` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `color` varchar(20) DEFAULT '#3B82F6',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `tags2_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `dncList2` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(320),
  `phone` varchar(30),
  `reason` text,
  `addedBy` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `dncList2_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
